lines: FIX03 opened on branch fix03-in-20260910 at 85846c48db56a9916d68372becf3967dc2c9d02b, confirmed with git rev-parse HEAD and not transcribed from prose.
Claimed all three before reading any family content: in_conviction_d6-set, in_conviction_felony-set and in_conviction_misd-set, all CLAIM_OK FIX03 (repair, grant set efe991352bff7732).

Read vf30's three full rows before planning. Built on its measurements rather than redoing them: its seven-page directional difference, its structural no-finalizer finding, and its six ARTIFACTS breaches were all re-confirmed here rather than re-derived.
Confirmed the bytes had not moved: sha256sum over all twelve committed fixtures at 85846c48d reproduces every digest vf30 recorded at 4761ef4fd.

Confirmed determinism before editing: each UNCHANGED builder run at this base reproduced all four of its committed PDFs byte for byte. Two report files move on any rebuild here for unrelated reasons (re-pinned central records, and a shared caption-harvest module that now strips control characters); recorded in the rows file so the repair diff is not read as causing them.

Checked exclusiveScript and importedBy in MASTER_QUEUE.json before touching anything: all three are exclusiveScript true, importedBy [], and nothing in scripts/ or src/ imports them. No shared host, no sibling rebuild owed.

in_conviction_d6-set: repaired ARTIFACTS (four internal-record-text sites on the filings, two unlabelled engineer directives off the guidance PDFs, labelled copy below left intact) and REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING (the filing instruction no longer tells the participant to sign a judge's order; all seven order blanks now reach the guide under the label the order prints). Re-measured 0 added and 0 removed on all seven retained pages of both fixtures at grey <= 128, 300 dpi grayscale, and across a 96-160 threshold sweep, with the annotated source render proved by a 13,951-pixel annotated-versus-control difference. Acceptance receipt withdrawn with both digests through carryForwardGovernance and kept as history. COMPLETED, rasterState BUILT_RASTER_PENDING, no verdict set.

Confirmed baseline determinism for the felony and misd builders too, before their repair build: both UNCHANGED builders run at 85846c48d reproduced all four of their committed PDFs byte for byte, so the header claim covers all three families and not only d6.

in_conviction_felony-set: repaired ARTIFACTS (the same six sites as the siblings) and REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING (the same order-signing contradiction), plus the KNOWN_PREFILLS defect unique to this family. Its canonical fixture cause number carried charge-level token F6 three lines above a stated offence level of Level 5 felony, and the identical string was in use by in_conviction_d6-set whose stated level IS Level 6. Changed the token only, to F5. The controlling record IN.memo.json establishes NO cause number for this route, and no charge-level token table exists anywhere in this repository or in mounted custody; the change rests on internal consistency with the family's own page and with the repository's five other Indiana fixture cause numbers, and the row says so rather than dressing it up as record authority. Re-measured 0 added and 0 removed on all seven retained pages of both fixtures at grey <= 128, 300 dpi grayscale, across a 96-160 sweep, with the annotated render proved on this family's own insert at 10,250 pixels. Acceptance receipt withdrawn with both digests. COMPLETED, no verdict set.

in_conviction_misd-set: repaired ARTIFACTS (the same six sites) and REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING (the same order-signing contradiction, and all seven order blanks now in the guide under the printed label). KNOWN_PREFILLS was PASS here and stays PASS: both cause numbers carry a CM token beside a stated Class A misdemeanor. Re-measured 0 added and 0 removed on all seven retained pages of both fixtures at grey <= 128, 300 dpi grayscale, across a 96-160 sweep, with the annotated render proved on this family's own insert CCA-XP-0220-7008 at 15,842 pixels. Acceptance receipt withdrawn with both digests. COMPLETED, no verdict set.

Three families returned, three receipts withdrawn (the verifier's withdrawn-receipt count moved 19 -> 20 -> 21), no shared module touched, no central artifact edited, no flatten introduced, no raster dispatched, no claim released or transferred, and no verdict set by this lane.

Two findings this lane measured and did NOT act on, both reported in the rows file for dispatch rather than repaired here: in_conviction_d6-set's BOUNDARY fixture pairs cause number 45C01-0812-FB-... with a stated offence level of Class D felony, which is the same copied-constant defect vf30 failed the felony CANONICAL for and which vf30 recorded as KNOWN_PREFILLS PASS on d6; and MASTER_QUEUE.json still carries completenessStatus PASS_COMPLETE with allNineCountersZero true on all three families beside state FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED.

Third finding measured and not acted on: all three builders publish flattenedWidgetAppearancesReadFromOutputBytes as a hardcoded literal 0 beside two real readings of its neighbours - the a-published-zero-where-a-measurement-existed shape. The zero is TRUE on these bytes and this lane confirmed it three independent ways, so nothing delivered is wrong; the literal is a latent one. Recorded in the rows file rather than repaired, because it changes no output and is outside these families' failed obligations.
